description: Phase B source-adapter expansion (ROADMAP.md Phase B; engine/docs/sources-linguistic.md §Glottolog + Decision §2). Glottolog 5.x is the authoritative open language-family tree and the doc's "best next target" for a dedicated dump adapter, still unbuilt (WALS/PHOIBLE + kaikki already shipped as US-002/US-004). Build a Glottolog CLDF category spec on top of the reusable dump adapter (106): ~26k languoids, glottocodes + ISO 639-3, emitting the DESCENDS_FROM genealogy as canonical edges and anchoring language nodes on glottocode (Wikidata P1394). CC-BY-SA 3.0, so the licence string must travel with each record. A glottolog job stub already exists at engine/inputs/jobs/glottolog.yml. Scope: the Glottolog spec + mapping + fixtures.

userStories.title: Glottolog CLDF spec emitting the family tree
userStories.description: Express Glottolog 5.x as a CLDF dump spec that the 106 adapter ingests, mapping the languoid family tree to DESCENDS_FROM edges and language nodes keyed on glottocode.
acceptanceCriteria: A Glottolog CLDF category/job spec (building on engine/inputs/jobs/glottolog.yml) ingests via the 106 dump adapter, mapping languages.csv Family_ID/Parent_ID to DESCENDS_FROM genealogy edges and language nodes carrying glottocode + ISO 639-3 (anchor Wikidata P1394).
The CC-BY-SA 3.0 licence + Glottolog provenance travels with every emitted record.
A hermetic test over a small Glottolog CLDF fixture asserts the genealogy edges + glottocode anchoring; `uv run --all-packages pytest engine/tests` passes.

userStories.title: Reconcile Glottolog language nodes with the corpus
userStories.description: Ensure Glottolog language nodes merge onto existing corpus language entities via glottocode/ISO rather than creating duplicates.
acceptanceCriteria: Glottolog nodes reconcile onto existing corpus languages by glottocode/ISO 639-3 (no duplicate language nodes), covered by a reconciliation test.
The engine gate is green: `uv run ruff check .` (engine) and `uv run mypy src` (engine).
`.chief/verify.sh` passes; the spec JSON/YAML and any fixture JSON parse.
